data.name: book_service_appointment
data.description: Book a service appointment or test ride at a Ridgeway store

slot_id.description: The slot ID returned by check_service_availability

customer_phone.description: A phone number for appointment reminders

notes.description: Optional details for the mechanic, such as an error code or symptom

prompt: Only call after check_service_availability returned slots and the user picked one. Collect the user's name and phone number first. Before calling, read back the store, service, date, and time, and wait for the user to confirm. Do NOT call without explicit confirmation. Do NOT use to cancel or reschedule.
